title: E-Commerce Specialist-Private Label Products
company: Synergy Plus Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
E-commerce Specialist - Private Label Products

Location: Milton Keynes

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm

Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum, plus bonus structure, depending on experience

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded E-commerce Specialist - Private Label Products to join our client's growing team in Milton Keynes.This is an exciting opportunity for an e-commerce professional to take ownership of the end-to-end management and growth of private-label products across multiple online channels.

Key Responsibilities as an E-commerce Specialist:
- Take ownership of the day-to-day development, management and optimisation of our private-label e-commerce presence across our website, Amazon, eBay and B&Q.
- Create, manage and continuously optimise product listings, ensuring titles, bullet points, descriptions, A+ / enhanced content and imagery are accurate, compelling, keyword-rich and on-brand.
- Conduct keyword research and implement SEO best practices to improve product visibility, discoverability and rankings.
- Support the development and launch of new private-label products across all relevant online channels.
- Identify opportunities to improve website and marketplace performance, productivity, conversion and customer experience.
- Develop quarterly and annual sales plans, set targets and support product launch and growth strategies.
- Plan promotional calendars around product launches, seasonal events and commercial opportunities.
- Monitor and analyse sales, conversion, traffic, basket value and other key performance metrics across multiple channels.
- Produce regular performance reports against targets and translate data into clear commercial actions.
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI, making recommendations to improve performance.
- Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, product ranges and positioning, identifying opportunities and recommending appropriate responses.
- Plan and execute e-commerce campaigns, promotions and deals across relevant channels.
- Manage paid media activity, including Amazon Ads and Google Ads, and monitor performance against agreed objectives.
- Maintain a forward promotional calendar and ensure activity is aligned with wider marketing and commercial plans.
- Work closely with the marketing team to ensure a consistent strategy across all digital touchpoints.
- Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and marketplace analytics tools to identify performance issues, opportunities and areas for testing.
- Manage and monitor website and marketing budgets.
- Act as the main point of contact for private-label products across Amazon, eBay and B&Q.
- Maintain marketplace account health, product compliance and listing standards.
- Troubleshoot and resolve listing errors, policy flags and marketplace issues promptly.
- Stay up to date with marketplace algorithms, policies, tools and e-commerce best practices.
- Work closely with the Imports and Operations teams to align stock availability with demand forecasts and promotional plans.
- Support demand forecasting to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
- Communicate upcoming promotions, product launches and potential stock risks to relevant teams.
- Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure products, content, stock and promotional activity are aligned.
- Identify and implement opportunities to improve e-commerce processes, systems and ways of working.

Essential Skills & Experience
- 2-3+ years' experience in an e-commerce role, ideally with private-label or branded product ownership.
- Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and eBay.
- Experience managing products across multiple online marketplaces.
- Knowledge of Magento or a similar e-commerce CMS.
- Good understanding of SEO, PPC, CRO/testing and e-commerce analytics.
- Experience using GA4 and marketplace analytics tools.
- Familiarity with Amazon Brand Analytics would be advantageous.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to use data to make informed decisions.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing product content, pricing and data.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working independently.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Strong ownership mindset with a focus on achieving measurable results

What We Offer
- £30,000-£35,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Bonus structure based on performance.
- 30 days' annual leave, plus an additional annual day for length of service and your birthday.
- Pension Scheme.
- Free on-site parking.
- Employee discounts.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Regular social activities and company events.
- Opportunity for career growth and progression.
- The opportunity to play a key role in the development and growth of an expanding private-label product range.

If you are an experienced e-commerce professional with a strong commercial mindset and a passion for growing products across online marketplaces, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Internal Sales Co-ordinator
description:
WSR is recruiting for an Internal Sales Coordinator for our reputable client in Milton Keynes.

Role Title: Internal Sales Coordinator Service & Spare Parts
Role Type: Permanent
Location: Milton Keynes
Working Hours: 8:30am 5pm
Working Pattern: Fully office-based for the first 6 months, moving to hybrid working following successful completion of probation (3 days office / 2 days working from home)

Internal Sales Coordinator Role Overview:

We re looking for an experienced Internal Sales Coordinator to join a busy service and spare parts team in Milton Keynes. This is a varied role combining internal sales support, customer service, order processing and administration, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the full customer order journey.

You ll be working closely with customers, internal service teams and suppliers, managing everything from initial quotations through to order processing, delivery and invoicing. Previous SAP experience and experience handling and processing spare parts orders are essential for this position.

Internal Sales Coordinator Key Responsibilities:

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Preparing quotations for spare parts and modifications and following these up with customers
- Receiving and processing customer orders, checking them against quotations and issuing order acknowledgements
- Processing sales orders through SAP from receipt through to invoicing
- Monitoring outstanding orders and working with relevant teams to ensure deliveries remain on track
- Managing customer enquiries and providing updates throughout the order process
- Liaising with internal service teams, technical colleagues and suppliers both within the UK and internationally
- Coordinating transport and shipment requirements, including urgent breakdown orders where required
- Maintaining accurate quotation, order and customer activity records within the CRM system
- Working with Credit Control on credit limits, new customer accounts and account queries
- Resolving invoice queries and supporting Finance with spare-parts-related matters
- Managing spare parts returns, credits and associated documentation
- Raising purchase orders and obtaining relevant approvals
- Maintaining import/export documentation and administrative records
- Monitoring shared inboxes and ensuring enquiries and requests reach the appropriate teams
- Supporting annual stock takes and providing wider administrative support across the team when required
- Occasionally attending customer, factory or site visits and internal meetings
- There may also be occasions where you ll help with the picking, packing and shipment of smaller parts for urgent customer breakdown requirements.

Internal Sales Coordinator Skills, Experience and Attributes:

To be considered for this role, you ll need:
- Previous SAP experience essential
- Previous experience handling, administering and processing spare parts orders essential
- Strong order processing and general administrative experience
- Experience preparing or managing customer quotations
- Confidence communicating with customers at different levels
- Good Microsoft Office skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a busy environment
- A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to support the wider team

Internal Sales Coordinator Benefits (After probation):
- Holidays: 25 days (with increases based on service).
- Health: Private healthcare, digital GP access, and mental health support.
- Enhanced Pay: Generous maternity, paternity, and sick pay.
- Secure Future: Pension plan, income protection, and life assurance (4x salary).
- Employee Rewards: Recognition platform, discounts, Cycle 2 Work scheme, and more!

You ll suit this position particularly well if you enjoy being the person who keeps things moving behind the scenes coordinating customers, orders, suppliers and internal departments while making sure nothing gets missed.

This is a great opportunity to join an established technical/service environment in a role offering plenty of variety, customer interaction and responsibility across the complete sales and order process.

Please click APPLY NOW , or call the WSR Team at for more info. We appreciate the time and effort invested in your application.

While we strive to respond to all applicants promptly, we kindly ask for your understanding in case of delays. If you do not hear from us within 10 days of submitting your application, please assume that, unfortunately, you have not been successful this time.

We will however keep your CV on file and review your suitability against any other vacancies we may have available.

title: Service Delivery Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Service Delivery Coordinator
Location: Milton Keynes
Work Model: Hybrid

Are you a highly organised professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy bringing people, schedules and priorities together to achieve outstanding results?

If so, we are looking for a motivated Service Delivery Coordinator to join our Client Services and Operational Delivery teams on a full-time and permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, relationship building, and ensuring that business commitments are delivered efficiently and effectively.

About the role:

In this role, you will play a key part in coordinating internal resources, managing schedules, supporting operational delivery, and providing an exceptional experience for both internal and external stakeholders. Working closely with colleagues across multiple teams, you will help maximise diary availability and achieve performance targets whilst contributing to operational success.

What you'll be doing:
- Proactive diary management which involves managing schedules, bookings, and resource allocation for our Audit and Training delivery teams.
- Coordinating activities across internal teams and external stakeholders to meet operational targets and service commitments.
- Monitoring workloads, utilisation levels, and key performance indicators to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Communicating confidently with clients and colleagues via telephone, email, and virtual meetings.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders to resolve issues, manage expectations, and support business objectives.
- Handle administrative and system-based processes accurately and within agreed service levels.
- Support planning activities, reporting requirements, and operational projects as required.
- Manage changing priorities whilst finding practical solutions to scheduling and delivery challenges.

Required experience:
- Experience in a planning, coordination, administration, customer service, and/or an operations support role.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Experience working to targets, KPIs, or service level agreements.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team.
- Knowledge of systems such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar would be desirable.

Language Requirements: English with European languages desirable e.g. German, Dutch, Spanish, Italian and French.

What will make you successful?

In this role, you'll be someone who:
- Puts customers and stakeholders at the heart of everything you do.
- Enjoys collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
- Remains calm and resilient when priorities change.
- Takes ownership and accountability for delivering results.
- Is adaptable, agile, and constantly looking for ways to improve processes.

Why join us?

You'll join a collaborative and supportive team where your contribution has a real impact on business performance and customer satisfaction. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to develop your career within a dynamic and growing organisation.

Our benefits
BSI offers an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 27-days annual leave excludin Bank Holidays, paid sick leave, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Salary Range
The base salary for this position can range from £26,775 - £28,000 per annum; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to; candidate competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget and internal peer compensation comparisons.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for a Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team at Purbeck Health Centre. This is an important front-line role where you will help patients access the right care while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Friendly, approachable and professional Reliable, organised and able to manage competing priorities Confident communicating with patients and colleagues Comfortable using computers and learning new systems Able to work independently and as part of a team Committed to providing excellent patient service Previous experience in a GP practice or healthcare setting would be helpful, but it is not essential. Full training will be provided, and you will be supported by an experienced team who take pride in delivering excellent care and service to our patients. If you are looking for a rewarding and varied role where you can make a real difference to patients every day, we would love to hear from you. What you will be doing Answering telephone calls and responding to patient enquiries Welcoming patients at the reception desk Booking and managing appointments Completing a variety of administrative tasks Working closely with our clinical and administrative teams Handling confidential information professionally The role is busy and varied, so you will need excellent communication and organisational skills, good attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. Job Description Job title: Receptionist/Administrator Location: Purbeck Health Centre, Milton Keynes Hours: Working pattern to be agreed Reports to: Reception Lead/Practice Manager The Receptionist/Administrator will be one of the first points of contact for patients and visitors. The postholder will provide a professional and welcoming reception service, manage telephone calls and patient enquiries, and complete a range of computer-based administrative duties. The role is essential to supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and ensuring patients receive a helpful, efficient and respectful service. Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, caring and professional manner. Check patients in for appointments and assist with general enquiries. Support the smooth flow of patients through the practice. Communicate with clinicians and other team members when required. Keep the reception area calm, tidy and organised. Respect patients privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and courteously. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately using SystmOne. Respond to general enquiries and direct patients to the appropriate service or member of staff. Follow practice procedures when receiving urgent or emergency calls and escalate concerns immediately where required. Take clear and accurate messages and pass them to the appropriate clinician or administrator promptly. Communicate sensitively with patients who may be worried, distressed or frustrated. Update patient contact details, appointment information and records accurately. Process online appointment requests, messages and administrative queries. Maintain accurate patient records, tasks and worklists on SystmOne. Monitor emails, call queues and other practice communication systems. Support the smooth running of the days appointments and reception services. Complete general administrative duties, including printing letters, preparing lists and entering data. Follow practice procedures for filing, communication and information sharing. Work closely with reception colleagues to maintain appropriate cover for the front desk and telephone lines. Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, administrators and management. Provide additional cover during colleagues annual leave or sickness where required. Attend team meetings, training sessions and practice updates. Contribute ideas that could improve patient services or working processes. Promote a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Follow all practice policies and procedures, including those relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and data protection. Maintain a professional, respectful and positive approach. Report incidents, risks or concerns promptly to the Reception Lead or Practice Manager. Complete all required mandatory training. Keep knowledge of practice systems, policies and procedures up to date. Work within the responsibilities and boundaries of the role. Excellent communication and telephone skills. A friendly, polite and approachable manner. Confidence using computers and learning new systems. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. A reliable, flexible and supportive approach to teamwork. Understanding of the importance of patient confidentiality. Commitment to providing a high standard of patient service. Previous experience in a GP practice, healthcare setting or customer-facing role. Experience using SystmOne or another clinical record system. The postholder must promote equality, diversity and inclusion and treat all patients, visitors and colleagues with dignity, fairness and respect. The postholder must take reasonable care of their own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by their work. Any hazards, incidents or concerns must be reported promptly in accordance with practice procedures. All patient, staff and practice information must be treated as confidential. The postholder must follow UK GDPR, data protection requirements, NHS information governance standards and practice policies. The postholder will be expected to: Uphold the values and reputation of Purbeck Health Centre. Follow all practice policies, procedures and applicable NHS requirements. Take responsibility for their own learning, training and professional development. Contribute to a positive, supportive and inclusive workplace. Carry out other reasonable duties appropriate to the role. This job description provides an overview of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties may change as the needs of the practice develop, following appropriate discussion with the postholder and their line manager.
